item.title: Tiny golden brushed quadcopter
item.description: Utilizing f8 fc brushed AIO this build became quite neat! The frame is create by carbon fibre tubes (4x2) and 3D-printed adaptors and motor mounts. The 3D printed parts and motors are held together with pressfit and epoxy. There are 4 threaded inserts in the middle for the flight controller (30.5 x 30.5). Once everything was put together I had to add some nice paint to it! Components Component Details Amount Price each [$] Link Flight controller AIO f8 fc 1 20 Github Motor 8520 3.

item.title: f8 fc
item.description: The open-source brushed AIO flight controller for x8 drones. f8 fc is a fully open source flight controller that is made primarily for small drones with brushed drones. It features: STM32F405 microcontroller with 1MB flash BMI270 imu BMP388 barometer Onboard 16MB external flash for data logging Status LEDs 1-4s input voltage 4 available UARTs 8 brushed motor drives with 6A mosfets Voltage & current sensing Runs ardupilot How to flash Ardupilot Get ardupilot toolchain and put the hwdef.

item.title: The worlds smallest x8 drone with brushed motors
item.description: I’ve wanted to build a mini x8 drone with brushed motors for some time it’s finally time! Everything is first sketched and modelled in Fusion360. Project Goal Build a tiny x8 drone with brushed motors that can fly with Ardupilot.
